question: When we delete any file using delete key only, the file goes to the _______.
solution:
The correct answer is **__Recycle bin.__**

__
 
• **The Recycle Bin** is a location where deleted files or folders are temporarily stored in every version of Microsoft Windows since Windows 95.
 
• The recycle bin is similar to **Apple's Trash application.**
 
• The Recycle Bin allows users to** recover files** that were deleted in Windows.
 
• If one holds down the **Shift key** when deleting a file, it will prevent it from going to the Recycle Bin.
